system.description: • Effect: On a night the GM names (a moon or a turning of the season, about once a season), you may brew the Ninth Moon: one effect of Wish cast as a Ritual (see Wish in Spellcasting in Arneyan), with no Exhaustion and for half the cost of its components. Anything beyond that list needs the GM's leave, and the Cauldron then leaves a mark on you.

activities.name: Cauldron Ritual
activities.text: On a night the GM names (a moon or a turning of the season, about once a season), brew the Ninth Moon: one effect of Wish cast as a Ritual, with no Exhaustion and for half the cost of its components. Anything beyond Wish's list needs the GM's leave, and the Cauldron then leaves a mark on you.

activities.name: Cauldron Ritual (monthly)
activities.text: From 24th level, once a month, on any night: one effect of Wish cast as a Ritual, with no Exhaustion and for half the cost of its components. Anything beyond Wish's list needs the GM's leave, and the Cauldron then leaves a mark on you.
